turn.speaker: sara
turn.text: It's been a while since we last cooked up a meal together. Maybe it's time we try some new recipes and see what we like. Let's brainstorm some ideas and see which ingredients and techniques will give us the best results. After all, a good recipe is the first step towards a delicious meal. How about we start by trying a dish that requires a lot of work, such as a vegetable stew. It might take a bit of time and effort.
